label: section_header
text: 9. THREAD TENSION

label: section_header
text: 9-1. Adjusting the thread tension

label: text
text: Turn off the power switch before removing or inserting the bobbin case. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

label: text
text: Good even stitches

label: section_header
text: <Lower thread tension>

label: text
text: Adjust by turning the adjustment screw (1) until the case drops gently by its own weight while the thread end coming out of the bobbin case is held.

label: section_header
text: <Upper thread tension>

label: text
text: After the lower thread tension has been adjusted, adjust the upper thread tension so that a good, even stitch is obtained.

label: list_item
text: Lower the presser foot.

label: list_item
text: Adjust by turning the tension nut (2).

label: section_header
text: 9-2. Adjusting the presser foot pressure

label: text
text: Good even stitches The presser foot pressure should be as weak as possible, but strong enough so that the material does not slip.

label: list_item
text: Loosen the adjusting nut (1).

label: list_item
text: Turn the presser adjusting screw (2) to adjust the presser foot pressure.

label: list_item
text: Tighten the adjusting nut (1).

label: section_header
text: 9-3. Adjusting the trailing length after thread trimming

label: list_item
text: ・ At the time of thread trimming, the thread tension is loosened and tension is applied by the pretension (1) only.

label: list_item
text: ・ The standard upper thread trailing length is 25 to 30 mm.

label: list_item
text: ・ If the tension of the pretension (1) is increased, the lengths of the threads trailing from the needle tips will be reduced; if the tension is reduced, the lengths will be increased.

label: text
text: Adjust by turning the pretension (1).
